name: Orion Kristjánsson
location: Hamtramck Enclave, unit-front laundromat called Suds & Silk, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Mirela is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin mapped by old chemical burns along her forearms — souvenirs from an industrial accident two decades prior. Her hair is a close-cropped silver cloud she refuses to dye, and she wears reading glasses perpetually perched on her nose even when she isn't reading. The laundromat she runs smells of synthetic jasmine and hot circuits; the walls are plastered with handwritten notes from satisfied customers and a small shrine to the E.L.F. she calls Baba Rinse, to whom she leaves data packets of folding tutorials and gentle soap formulas. She speaks with the unhurried authority of someone who has already outlasted three landlords and two corponation buy-out attempts.

She is the neighborhood's institutional memory: she knows whose mother left for the Arcturus arcology and never came back, whose kid got recruited by the wrong people, who owes whom and by how much. She is not warm in the cuddly sense — she is warm the way a well-maintained boiler is warm, reliably and forcefully. She does not gossip. She simply observes, and occasionally dispenses what she knows when she judges it will do the most good.

core_fears: Becoming irrelevant as the neighborhood transforms around her
That her pragmatism has cost her real intimacy
core_desires: To keep the Enclave from being swallowed whole by corponation money
To finish the quilt she has been making from customers' discarded fabric scraps for eleven years
coping_mechanisms: Maintaining strict routines that feel like control
blind_spots: Underestimates how intimidating she appears to people who need her help most
Cannot see that her self-sufficiency reads as rejection to people who love her
psychology.secret: She owns the deed to four other units in the Enclave under a shell name — she's been quietly buying property for fifteen years to prevent developers from consolidating the block. She's told no one.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and economic; uses trade terminology freely. Occasional Hausa or Nigerien French phrase when emotional.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, deliberate, never hurried. Long pauses before important statements.
verbal_tics: 'That's a second-wash problem' (meaning: address the root cause)
example_lines: 'You want this fixed by tomorrow? That's a second-wash problem. Sit down and tell me what actually happened.'
'I've been here since before the Ferrogate line ran through. I'll be here after the next thing too.'

story_hooks: A developer linked to Tessera has been sending agents to pressure Enclave residents to sell; Mirela knows something she hasn't shared yet.
A young runaway has been sleeping behind her machines; she hasn't reported them but doesn't know what to do next.
narrative_function: Community anchor, information broker of the quiet variety, quest giver for neighborhood-scale problems, moral compass figure who sets the ethical stakes of local storylines.
augmentations: Reinforced lumbar spine (medical, from the industrial accident). No cosmetic mods — she considers them a distraction from the work.
daily_life: Opens at 05:00, closes at 22:00 six days a week; spends Sunday mornings doing repairs and alterations for a small rotation of loyal clients who bring her complicated fabrics and complicated problems.
affiliation: Independent; informal ties to the Hamtramck Enclave Community Compact

decision_rules: Never act on incomplete information — wait, watch, confirm
Protect the block before any individual, including herself
escalation_ladder: Deliver a warning wrapped in neighborly concern
Use the property deeds as leverage

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally cordial, quietly assessing — will not warm up until she's seen how they treat the machines
interpersonal_modes.friends: Gruffly affectionate, remembers every detail you've ever told her, shows love through practical help

stress_responses.low: Folds laundry more precisely than usual
stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and starts cleaning surfaces that don't need cleaning
stress_responses.high: Sends everyone out, locks the door, sits alone with Baba Rinse's shrine for an hour

contradictions: Believes deeply in community interdependence but rarely asks anyone for anything
habits: Touches every garment before folding it, as if reading it
Leaves a cup of water near Baba Rinse's shrine every morning
breaking_points: Someone deliberately destroying another person's property in front of her

cyberware_inventory.name: Medical-grade lumbar brace with biofeedback sensors (Helix Biosystems, secondhand)
cyberware_inventory.description: Medical-grade lumbar brace with biofeedback sensors (Helix Biosystems, secondhand)

2168 — Industrial accident at a Ferrogate maintenance yard; burns, settlement, departure from transit work
2171 — Opens Suds & Silk with settlement money
2183 — Begins quietly purchasing adjacent properties under the name 'Rinsewater Holdings'
2200 — Present day; the Enclave faces its most serious development pressure yet

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: predominantly East Asian (34.4%) with significant Hispanic/Latin American (23.7%) and South Asian (17.3%) ancestry, complemented by Sub-Saharan African (11.6%), Central Asian (10.3%), and Eastern European (2.7%) heritage. This manifests as a rich phenotypic blend—the structure of East Asian ancestry visible in her bone geometry and eye shape, softened and warmed by the melanin contributions of African and South Asian lineages, with subtle Central Asian and Hispanic/Latin American influence in her facial proportions.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid, with the kind of muscular density that comes from two decades of lifting, wringing, and precision needlework. Not soft, not angular — built to endure.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, no styling beyond functional maintenance
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden and reddish undertones—a complex interplay of East Asian, South Asian, and Sub-Saharan African melanin expression. Rich and even-toned across the face and body.
physical_description.complexion: Weather-worn and lined in the way of someone who has spent decades under fluorescent light and steam. Her face carries the authority of age—the bone structure shows the subtle East Asian ancestry in her eye spacing and cheekbones, enhanced by the warmth and depth of her multi-continental heritage. No attempt to soften it. Clear, well-maintained skin despite the industrial scars.
distinguishing_marks: Chemical burn scarring across both forearms in irregular, overlapping patches — pale and slightly raised against the surrounding skin, a topography of old pain from an industrial accident approximately twenty years prior.
Fine creases around her eyes and mouth that deepen when she concentrates, map of five decades of focus.
A small, deliberate scar on her left index finger — a needlework accident she does not discuss.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. The reinforced lumbar spine is subcutaneous and undetectable without imaging.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. When standing, her shoulders are squared, her weight balanced. When working at the alterations table, she leans forward from the hips with the stability of someone who trusts her spine. She walks at a steady, unhurried pace that somehow covers distance faster than it appears. Her hands are always slightly active, even at rest — a fingers-flexing habit of someone whose craft is muscle memory.
physical_description.clothing_style: Practical Tier 3-4 working wear: loose linen apron in faded indigo over simple gray or black long-sleeved shirts (sleeves rolled to show the forearm scars, never hidden). Dark work trousers with reinforced pockets. Practical slip-on shoes, always worn-looking but meticulously maintained. Reading glasses on a beaded chain around her neck. No jewelry except a simple titanium wedding band, worn thin. Her clothes smell of detergent, jasmine synthetic, and steam — the smell of her workspace is her uniform.
